extension.summary: Apple TV-inspired skin with widgets and Player Info.
extension.description: Pyrus Skin by kamilwhoo brings an Apple TV-inspired interface to Kodi: configurable widgets, three custom hubs, inline submenus, focus-driven navigation, search and playback controls. Includes native Live TV/Radio entry points, episode titles, provider/native ratings and Player Info with Media, Decoder / Output and System tabs. Full widget/menu backups and on-demand diagnostics are available. The maintainer has tested the skin on Kodi 22; this update requires device validation. Full p3i build compatibility is not certified. Independent community project; not affiliated with Apple or Team Kodi.
extension.news: 1.1.3: Added a Power button beside Settings on the home navigation bar. It opens Kodi Power Options, including Reboot when the device supports it. English-only skin catalog. Pyrus Skin by kamilwhoo.
